name: CWIP Asset Entry
description: CWIP asset capitalisation data entry widget

getData.description: Returns all rows as a JSON string.

getSelectedData.description: Returns selected rows as a JSON string.

setData.description: Replaces all rows. Each row should contain assetId, assetClass, and capitalizedMonth.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: JSON array of asset records. Use YYYY-MM for capitalizedMonth.

setCellValue.description: Sets a single cell value and re-renders.

setOptions.description: Sets the default Asset Class dropdown options.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: JSON array of values or objects with value and text properties.

setRowOptions.description: Sets Asset Class dropdown options for a particular row.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: JSON array of dropdown values or objects with value and text properties.

onReady.description: Fires when the widget is mounted.

onDataChange.description: Fires for loadData, saveChanges, row selection, and selectAll. Use getLastEvent() to read the payload.

onFieldChange.description: Fires when Asset Class or Capitalized Month changes. Payload: fieldChange|rowIndex|fieldName|value.

onValidate.description: Fires when Validate is clicked. Payload: VALID|0 or INVALID|n.

onClear.description: Fires when editable values are cleared. Payload: clear|rowCount.
